---
title: Show one number against the bands that give it meaning
description: A gauge places a single value on an arc whose bands the author sets, so the reader sees where it stands without a grade the data did not carry.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Satisfaction sits in the fair band

This illustrative survey score is 72 on a scale of 0 to 100. The bands are the team's own thresholds; RichView draws them as written and grades nothing itself.

```chart
type: gauge
title: Customer satisfaction is fair, short of good
subtitle: Survey score out of 100
data:
  inline:
    - {measure: Satisfaction, score: 72}
encoding: {x: measure, y: score}
axes:
  y: {label: Score}
style:
  min: 0
  max: 100
  bands:
    - {to: 50, label: Poor}
    - {to: 75, label: Fair}
    - {to: 100, label: Good}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read the value, its band and the scale.
